evidence.quote: Concerns intensified after the Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia is in talks to provide $250 billion in financing to OpenAI as part of a data center project in Ohio.
evidence.one_line: Calcalist于2026-07-28转述《华尔街日报》称，英伟达正洽谈为OpenAI俄亥俄州数据中心项目提供2500亿美元融资。
evidence.speaker: Calcalist

evidence.quote: According to Jefferies, investors view the proposed arrangement as a prominent example of "circular financing," in which financing provided by a supplier ultimately helps generate demand for its own products.
evidence.one_line: Calcalist于2026-07-28称，Jefferies认为拟议中的融资安排是循环融资的突出案例，供应商提供的融资最终有助于为其自身产品创造需求。
evidence.speaker: Calcalist
